title: I trained a playable diffusion world model of Pokémon Red, plus a game agent harness on the same System 1/2 split as Krafton's PUBG Ally. Can this be ICLR-workshop worthy? [P]
summary: 1. The world model: the game, dreamed by a neural net A diffusion model (same family as image generators) that learned Pokémon Red frame by frame from recorded play. Give it the last 4 screens and a button press, and it draws the next screen. 16.7M parameters, 72×80 greyscale, DI
